records.name: Benny Walker's
records.notes: Soft-opening hours reported as daily 4–8 PM at 444 Alvarado St, with longer 11 AM–10:30 PM hours possible as soon as Nov 11. Downtown association lists the venue but no standing schedule. Confirm the post-soft-opening schedule with the operator. The downtown association lists the operator’s Instagram but no phone number or permanent hours. Follow-up 2026-11-07: Current Old Monterey operator-directory entry https://www.oldmonterey.org/biz/benny-walkers confirms the restaurant at 444 Alvarado and Instagram @bennywalkersmonterey but still publishes no weekly hours. October 27 firsthand Edible Monterey Bay reporting confirms soft-opening daily 4–8 PM and describes 11 AM–10:30 PM from November 11 as possible, not effective. Rechecked November 7; no operator-published change date or post-soft-opening weekly schedule found. Keep unverified; do not treat anticipated November 11 hours as active.

records.name: Compact Disco — EAT takeout window
records.notes: Compact Disco’s June announcement gives a 2 AM close for the all-ages walk-up window at 420 Tyler Street on Friday and Saturday nights. Edible Monterey Bay reported 10 PM–2 AM on those nights in June. Later operator social posts describe different opening hours for the 21+ pub kitchen. The current downtown association listing confirms the window exists at 420 Tyler Street but omits hours. Confirm the current takeout window schedule separately from club, happy-hour and in-pub kitchen hours. See Monterey lists the venue phone as (831) 920-2518. Ask specifically for the all-ages EAT window. Uber Eats lists the same-address food menu for delivery but provides no current schedule for the physical walk-up window.

records.name: Whole Foods Market — Prepared Foods
records.notes: Call (831) 333-1600 for the Prepared Foods counter and hot bar. The location page confirms the hot bar but publishes only supermarket hours. Counter service may run on a different schedule. The location page’s embedded listing data describes the Hot Bar as an amenity without separate hours. Monterey’s Market Cocina and Market Sandwich each have a provisional daily 9 AM–8 PM lead in public listings. Waze also lists Market Cocina at those hours. The public listings may share an upstream source. Whole Foods lists both counters separately from the Hot Bar and publishes no hours for any of the three. Confirm the named counter and hot bar hours separately.
